items.title: Openness of the flat locus in the finite type case, via the finite presentation theorem

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves openness of the flat locus in the finite type case, with the additional conclusion that the restriction of the module to that locus is locally finitely presented relative to the base, by reduction to the finite presentation theorem (statement lines 4230-4245, tag 05IK-adjacent). The proof goes affine, embeds the source into an affine space over the base, applies the finite presentation theorem to the pushforward of the module, and then reads the flat locus of the module off the one computed upstairs using that the pushforward vanishes off the image and has the same stalks there, concluding relative finite presentation from the relative statements. The descent step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
